text:
nora_pr: URGENT: A tech blog just published an article that appears to have broken our embargo on the Optimize benchmark. They cited numbers and screenshots before the embargo lift at 11:00 PT. Need PR + eng to confirm if it's the same dataset and decide correction/DMCA? :rotating_light:

sam_engineering: Saw it. The screenshots are from our draft report but with slightly different labels. Looks like an early draft leak. We need to confirm whether any customer data is exposed.

diego_marketing: Ugh. We have scheduled social push at 11:05 PT. Pause all outbound. I'll freeze Buffer.

mike_sales: pausing prospect emails now. Anyone who already received the deck, flag me and I'll follow-up with updated guidance.

ops_bot: security_alert: potential leak detected; linked artifact hash matches internal draft v0.9 (non-prod).

olivia_ops: I'll pull the artifacts and scrub them. If customer IDs are present, we escalate to Legal.

nora_pr: Drafting reporter note: "Hi — we noticed an early posting that appears to use a draft version of our benchmark. The embargo for the finalized report is 11:00 PT; we'd appreciate taking down the post until then. Happy to provide the final report at embargo lift. Best, Nora (PR)." Thoughts?
sam_engineering: Keep it neutral and request takedown. Also ask if they pulled screenshots from a Slack channel or a shared drive 1: that tells us scope.
diego_marketing: Sending hold message to partners: "Hold on all syndication until 11:05 PT. We'll ping when live."

press_bot: reporter_email_delivered: true

nora_pr: Reporter replied: "Thanks for the note. We'll temporarily unpublish and await the embargoed asset at 11:00 PT." They asked how we want the correction phrased.

sam_engineering: Great. Ops: any PII leaked?
olivia_ops: Quick scan: no customer PII, only internal metric names and a draft chart. I've revoked the share link and rotated the draft artifact access.

mike_sales: Ok to resume outbound at 11:10 PT? Need final confirmation from PR.

diego_marketing: I'll unfreeze Buffer and schedule the post for 11:05 PT only after PR confirms. Also prepping a short comment thread to explain the temporary takedown to followers.

nora_pr: Reporter confirmed takedown done and will republish at embargo lift with our suggested line: "The article was temporarily taken down to ensure accuracy; the final report is now live." I'll post here when live and then we amplify.

press_bot: article_update_detected: https://techblog.com/example-embargoed

nora_pr: Live now. Link above. Social push happened at 11:05 PT. Partners notified. Closing loop 61;✔
